meta.name: baoyu-format-markdown
meta.description: Formats plain text or markdown files with frontmatter, titles, summaries, headings, bold, lists, and code blocks. Use when user asks to "format markdown", "beautify article", "add formatting", or improve article layout. Outputs to {filename}-formatted.md.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给纯文本或 Markdown 文件添加标题、摘要、加粗等格式
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要快速美化文章或笔记的排版
copy.tagline_en: Add titles, summaries, bold, and more to plain text or Markdown files
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly beautify the layout of articles or notes

howto.what: 用户给一个文本或 Markdown 文件时,Claude 会把它整理成结构清晰的 Markdown:自动加上标题、摘要、加粗、列表、代码块等,保存为“原文件名-formatted.md”的新文件,并运行脚本修正中英文间距和标点。
howto.when: 当用户要求“格式化 Markdown”、“美化文章”等,或要求改善文章排版时触发。

say.text: 把这篇文章格式化成标准 Markdown
say.note: 会生成带标题、摘要和列表的新文件

say.text: 美化一下这个文本文件
say.note: 自动加粗重点、整理列表并保存新文件

say.text: 给这个 Markdown 文件排排版
say.note: 保留原结构,只修中英文间距和标点

howto.what_en: Turns plain text/Markdown into clean Markdown: adds frontmatter, title, summary, bold, lists, code blocks, saves as {filename}-formatted.md, then fixes CJK/English spacing and quotes.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to 'format markdown', 'beautify article', 'add formatting', or improve article layout.

say_en.text: Format this article into standard Markdown
say_en.note: Creates a new file with title, summary, lists
Bolds key points, organizes lists, saves new file

say_en.text: Improve the layout of this Markdown file
say_en.note: Keeps original structure, fixes spacing and punctuation
